# Forge

> Forge writes prompts in each AI model's own style, with the exact settings to match. Free, no account, and nothing you type leaves your browser.

Forge covers 57 AIs: Image (12), Video (11), Voice & speech (6), Sound effects (2), Music (5), Chat & reasoning (6), Coding agents (6), App builders (5), Research (4).

## Use it
- [Website](https://forge-prompt-smith.pages.dev/): pick an AI, say what you want, answer up to 3 questions, copy the prompt.
- Prompt Doctor: paste a prompt you already wrote; Forge scores it and rebuilds it.
- Reverse Forge: start from a picture or a file and get the prompt that makes more like it.
- Claude Code plugin: `/plugin marketplace add AlonAI4/forge`, then `/plugin install forge@forge`, then `/forge:forge <idea>`.
- Skill for Claude and ChatGPT: download forge-skill.zip from the website.

## Facts
- Made by Alon. Free to use, not to copy.
- Independent: not made by, approved by or connected to any company whose AI it writes for.
